description_en: Retrieves similar image clusters in a specified drive
description_zh: 获取指定 drive 空间下的相似图片
kebab_example: aliyun pds search-similar-image-clusters --drive-id 1 --marker YWRzX3VzZXJfcHJvZmlsZV9je1bnQh000 --limit 50 --order desc --image-thumbnail-process image/resize,m_fill,h_128,w_128,limit_0/format,jpg --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchSimilarImageClusters

parameters.description_en: The pagination marker. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the `next_marker` value from the previous response. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.
parameters.description_zh: 分页标记，从指定位置查询结果。若为空则表示从头开始查询。
parameters.help_en: The pagination marker. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the `next_marker` value from the previous response. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，从指定位置查询结果。若为空则表示从头开始查询
parameters.name: marker

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50. The number of results returned may be less than the specified limit.
parameters.description_zh:
限定此次返回结果的数量，取值范围\[1,100\]，默认50。
返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不能多于指定的数量。
